name: Kellogg's muesli nuts delight
ingredients_raw: WHEAT & WHEAT FLOUR (ATTA) (17.7%), CORN GRITS & CORN MEAL (17%), RICE (9.8%), SUGAR, ROLLED BARLEY (8.0%), ROLLED OATS (8.0%), ALMONDS (7%), SORGHUM (JOWAR) FLOUR (5.5%), RAGI FLOUR (5.2%), RAISINS (5%), PUMPKIN SEEDS (3%), CEREAL EXTRACT, OLIGOFRUCTOSE, WHEAT BRAN, COCOA SOLIDS, IODIZED SALT, CHOCO CRÈME {EMULSIFIER (INS 476)}, INVERT SUGAR, FLAVOURS {NATURE IDENTICAL & ARTIFICIAL (COCONUT, MARSHMALLOW, CARAMEL & VANILLA)}, VITAMINS, MINERALS, COLOUR (INS 150d) AND ANTIOXIDANT (INS 307b).
